jobs.title: People Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Join the Glowbar Team:**

Glowbar is reinventing the facial with custom, 30-minute treatments led by expert estheticians, designed to deliver results. Since launching in NYC in 2019, we’ve grown fast, with locations across the Northeast and more on the way.

The People Operations Coordinator keeps the engine of our Talent and Culture team running. You’re the person studio teams count on to get it right - every question answered, every system change made, every referral bonus paid accurately and on time. When the details are handled, our studio teams can stay focused on helping clients feel confident in their skin. If you love being the organized, reliable, detail-obsessed partner behind a great team member experience, this is your role.

**What You’ll Do:**

You’ll be the operational backbone of the Talent and Culture team, partnering with team members across our studios. Every day, you’ll:

* Own the inbox as the first point of contact for our studio teams - triaging questions on pay, policies, systems, and paperwork, resolving what you can quickly, and routing the rest to the right partner
* Keep our HRIS accurate by processing team member changes in ADP, including new hires, promotions, transfers, pay rate updates, status changes, and terminations, and managing user access in our systems as team members join and leave
* Support onboarding and offboarding administration in partnership with Talent Acquisition including new hire paperwork, I-9 and compliance documents, system setup, exit documentation, and fi nal pay coordination
* Support leave administration in partnership with the HRBP, including tracking leaves of absence, processing leave paperwork and status changes in ADP, and coordinating with carriers and state leave programs
* Administer benefits day to day, including new hire enrollment and eligibility, qualifying life events, COBRA notices, and coordination with our benefits brokers/carriers
* Handle routine employment requests such as employment and income verifi cations, unemployment claim responses, and wage garnishments, accurately and on time
* Track bonuses from referrals through eligibility to payout, so every team member who brings great people to Glowbar gets paid correctly and on time
* Support state payroll tax and unemployment registrations as Glowbar expands into new markets
* Maintain organized, audit-ready team member fi les, keep labor law postings current in every studio, and track handbook and policy acknowledgments
* Pull reports and data to support the Talent and Culture team as well as other cross-functional departments
* Turn repeat questions into resources by building and updating SOPs, templates, and FAQs that help studio teams self-serve

**Who We’re Looking For:**

* 1–3 years of experience in HR, People Operations, payroll, or administrative support
* Hands-on HRIS experience (ADP preferred); experience with multi-state payroll and benefits administration is a strong plus
* A detail-obsessed approach - you double-check the numbers because you know it matters to people
* Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to keep a busy inbox moving and prioritize what’s urgent
* Sound judgment and discretion with confidential information
* Clear, warm communication skills, especially in writing
* Enthusiasm for beauty, skincare, and a fast-paced, service-driven environment

**Your Glow Package (Compensation & Benefits):**

* Annual compensation increase eligibility
* Annual bonus potential tied to company EBITDA performance
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance largely covered by Glowbar
* Unlimited paid time off and sick leave
* 6 paid holidays
* DailyPay — access part of your paycheck before payday at no cost
* Disability, accident, critical illness, and life insurance coverage
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental wellness support
* Commuter benefits to help save on transit and parking
* Free annual Glowbar membership ($900 value) and two annual guest passes ($190 value)
* 30% employee discount off skincare products
* $150 employee referral bonuses for bringing great people to the team
* $15 product credit for every first-time client you refer

**Working Conditions:**

This is a fast-paced, primarily desk-based role. You should be comfortable with:

* Extended periods of computer work and managing a high volume of email and system tasks
* Occasional local travel to studios for team support and onboarding
* Handling confidential information with care and discretion

**Job Description**
-------------------

Agency Description:
  
  
The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3.7 million homes in New York City.
  
  
As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.  
  
  
  
Your Team:
  
  
The Office of Development (OOD) leads the agency’s effort to create and preserve affordable housing in collaboration with other HPD offices as well as other city, state and federal agencies. The OOD is comprised of eight divisions that administer a range of programs. These divisions include New Construction Finance, Special Needs Housing, Housing Incentives, Building and Land Development Services (BLDS), Homeownership Opportunities and Preservation, Preservation Finance, Portfolio Management and Conversions, and Compliance and Enforcement.  
  
  
  
The Division of Building and Land Development Services leads the agency’s effort in providing architectural, engineering, cost valuation, environmental planning, and construction support services to the various divisions within OOD. The Office of Development utilizes a public-private partnership model and provides loans, grants and/or incentives to assist in the finance of housing development projects that will benefit low- and moderate-income New Yorkers.
  
  
The Division of Building and Land Development Services is the largest division within the Office of Development with over 100 staff composed of seven units which include: the Bureau of New Construction Design Review Services, the Bureau of Preservation Design Review Services, the Bureau of Engineering, the Bureau of Construction Services, Environmental Planning Unit, the Policy Unit, and the Program Management Unit.
  
  
Your Impact:
  
  
As part of the BLDS Executive Office, the Assistant Project Manager, Interagency Coordination, will be responsible for assisting the team leading the Agency’s efforts to implement the city-wide housing initiative known as Accelerating and Streamlining Affordable Production (ASAP).
  
Your Role:
  
This role involves providing support to the Director of Interagency Coordination who will coordinate with internal and external partners and stakeholders to address various complex issues to further the ASAP housing initiative focused on interagency coordination for a large pipeline of HPD-financed affordable housing projects.
  
  
Your Responsibilities:
  
  

* Support the Director of Interagency Coordination with the division’s efforts in achieving the Agency’s and Division’s goals and objectives of accelerating the production of affordable housing.
* Assist with interagency coordination efforts for the division and support the Director of Interagency Coordination who will work closely with the Mayor’s Office and various external partners, including but not limited to, city agencies and utility companies, that are involved in the permitting and approval process for affordable housing projects with the goal of reducing timelines and obstacles to housing production.
* Assist with various operational tasks related to the ASAP housing initiative, including pipeline and data management and process mapping.
* Serve as a member of the ASAP task force and attend regularly scheduled meetings.
* Assist with the management of housing pipeline tracking tools, reports, and data analyses to be utilized by the ASAP task force and senior management teams.
* Coordinate with various teams within BLDS who oversee the tracking of project progress throughout the pre-development and construction phases.
* Engage in proactive engagement and coordination with an expanded group of external partners.

  
Preferred Skills
  
  
1. Candidates must be self-motivated, and work effectively with others.
  
2. The ideal candidate should have a background in Housing Development, Design and Construction, Program Management, Urban Planning and Development, or related field, and possess related professional experience.
  
3. Excellent trade base knowledge and familiarity with New York City government and housing issues.
  
4. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, negotiate with diverse technical specialists, apply independent judgment in technical matters and take initiative.
  
5. Ability to negotiate with diverse technical specialists, apply independent judgment in technical matters, take initiative, and work effectively with others.
  
6. Excellent writing, interpersonal, organizational, and communication skills.
  
7. Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, coordinate multiple projects, and deal with complex housing development issues.
  
8. Proficient in the operation of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and Powerpoint).
  
9. A Motor Vehicle Driver License valid in the State of New York may be required for certain assignments. If required, this license must be maintained for the duration of the assignment.
  
10. Candidate may be subject to a background investigation conducted by the New York City Department of Investigation.

jobs.description:
**AUTONOMY TO OWN YOUR PATH.**

**MOST SALESPEOPLE WORK A TERRITORY.**

***You're going to build one.***

*DuraServ is looking for a hunter — someone who doesn't wait for leads, doesn't need a manager standing over their shoulder, and doesn't stop until the deal is closed.*

**Built for People Who Build Markets. Own Your Territory, Drive Your Income.**

Are you a high-energy "hunter" who thrives on the adrenaline of a cold call and the satisfaction of a closed deal? We are looking for a resilient Outside Sales & Business Development Representative to dominate our local industrial market. In this role, you aren't just a salesperson; you are a problem-solving partner for facility managers and general contractors. Backed by a team of elite service technicians, you will identify operational bottlenecks, pitch high-performance dock and door solutions, and build a book of business with **uncapped commission potential**. If you are a social influencer who competes with an underdog's grit and a professional's accountability, your future and your paycheck starts here.

DuraServ is the market leader in commercial dock and door solutions — the essential infrastructure that keeps warehouses, distribution centers, and industrial facilities running. Our clients don't come to us. We go to them. We earn their business through preparation, persistence, and the ability to show up with a solution before they knew they had a problem.

**THE MISSION**

* **Aggressive Territory Prospecting:** Conduct daily "boots on the ground" cold calling and site visits with industrial parks and distribution hubs to identify new business opportunities.
* **Solution-Based Consulting:** Perform detailed site assessments to diagnose equipment needs (docks, levelers, high-speed doors) and provide custom-engineered solutions.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner closely with Service Technicians to turn maintenance leads and equipment failures into long-term service contracts and capital upgrades.
* **Relationship Management:** Build and maintain a robust pipeline by nurturing long-term relationships with facility managers, owners, and general contractors.
* **Proposal & Quote Management:** Utilize CRM tools to create meticulous, technically accurate proposals, ensuring all job specifications and safety requirements are met.
* **Market Influence:** Actively market our brand within the industrial sector, using a mix of social networking, drop-ins, and professional presentations to win market share.
* **Sales Cycle Ownership:** Manage the entire sales process from initial contact and discovery to contract negotiation and the final closing of the deal.
* **Responsive Problem Solving:** Act as the primary point of contact for clients during disruptions, providing optimistic and fast-paced solutions to keep their operations running.

**WHO YOU ARE**

**The Hunter Mentality:** A relentless drive to find and win new business without relying on inbound leads.

**Persuasive Communication:** The ability to influence decision-makers through high-energy storytelling and logical ROI presentation.

**Technical Aptitude:** The ability to understand and explain mechanical systems and industrial equipment functionality.

**Emotional Intelligence:** A high awareness of others' emotions to navigate tough negotiations and build instant rapport.

**Resilient Optimism:** The mental toughness to handle rejection and remain focused on the next win.

**Administrative Accountability:** Extreme attention to detail regarding tasks, procedures, and job specifications to ensure project accuracy.

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU**

**We don't believe in capping the earnings of people who perform. If you build the book, you earn accordingly. Period.**

* **Uncapped Earning Potential:** Performance-based pay with no income ceiling.
* **Autonomy & Trust:** Freedom from micromanagement, backed by leadership that respects your expertise.
* **Elite Team Environment:** Work alongside high-performing technicians — you sell it, they deliver it flawlessly.
* **Strong Foundation:** Full benefits package, 401(k) with match, generous PTO, vehicle allowance, and performance incentives.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* High School diploma or equivalent required; Associate or Bachelor's degree preferred.
* 2+ years of B2B sales experience with a proven track record in outside sales, industrial services, construction, or equipment leasing.
* Proven territory management experience — demonstrated ability to develop a cold territory into a profitable book of business.
* CRM proficiency with the ability to manage lead pipelines and technical data using modern sales tools.

**A Direct Note to the Right Candidate.**

If you've been in a sales role where the ceiling was artificial, where your leads were handed to you, or where the culture rewarded mediocrity the same way it rewarded performance — this is a different environment.

DuraServ's Outside Sales Representatives own their path. The territory is theirs. The relationships are theirs. The earnings are theirs. And the autonomy to build it the right way — their way — is backed by a leadership team that gets out of the way and lets performers perform.

**Autonomy to own your path. This is where that starts.**

**APPLY NOW — Positions Fill Fast.**

*Hit Apply. No long cover letters. Tell us what you've built and what you want to build next.*

DuraServ is a national leader in commercial dock and door solutions, operating across the U.S. and Canada since 2001. We partner with Fortune 500 distribution centers and regional operators alike. Our reputation is built on performance — and we hire accordingly.

jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**

  
  

ADT has been in the business of helping save lives since 1874. As the #1 smart home security provider in the U.S., we help protect and connect families, businesses and larger commercial customer every day. Our continuous innovation, advanced technology and strategic partnerships deliver products and services that help protect life and valuables, whether at home, your business or on the go. And as times change, so do we.Above all, our mission is clear: we help save lives for a living. Looking for a career where you can make a real impact? Join our team today and put purpose behind your paycheck. #WeAreADT

*Check out more about life at ADT* here.

**What you should know about our team:**

At ADT, our Sales team is at the heart of everything we do. We’re not just selling security systems, we’re helping protect what matters most. Whether it’s a family home or a small business, our sales professionals are trusted advisors who bring peace of mind to customers across the country.

**What you will do:**

As a Resale Sales Representative, you are not starting from scratch; you are reactivating interest and rebuilding trust with customers who already know ADT. That’s a powerful head start! These customers represent one of ADT’s strategic growth opportunities, and you will be at the forefront of re-introducing modern solutions that better meet this customer segment’s needs. You will:

* Re-engage previous customers, not cold-calling strangers. That means shorter sales cycles, higher conversion rates, and real potential to build lasting relationships.
* Provide personalized solutions that combine security, automation, and life safety features, all tailored to their space and lifestyle.

* Deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals to prospects, emphasizing the unique benefits and advantages of our products and services compared to competitors.
* Conduct post-installation follow-ups with customers to confirm that commitments were fulfilled and to generate referrals.
* Cultivate new business opportunities: identify and generate new sales leads to maximize outreach.

**What you need to be successful:**

We’re looking for self-motivated, tech-savvy individuals who are passionate about helping others and driven to succeed. If you thrive on connection, enjoy solving problems, and want to make a real impact while growing your career, you’ll fit right in.

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Willing to travel within a designated territory using your own vehicle (mileage reimbursed).
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving record required; additional licensing may be needed based on location.
* Comfortable using technology to stay organized, efficient, and accountable in a fast-paced sales environment.
* Self-motivated and results-driven, with an entrepreneurial mindset; you thrive on uncovering new leads and closing deals that deliver real value.
* Strong communicator and natural relationship builder, able to consult with customers, understand their needs, and guide them to the right solution.
* Adaptable and flexible; you excel in dynamic environments and enjoy learning new systems and approaches.
* Consumer sales experience is preferred but not required.

**How ADT invests in you:**

**Compensation:** Unlimited earning potential with uncapped commissions. Based upon performance, new sales advisors can expect to earn $105,000, while experienced sales advisors can earn over $150,000.

**Additional Pay:** We equip you with specialized training and the tools you need to meet your financial goals. For your first 8 weeks of training, you’ll earn up to $4,000.

**Benefits:**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Tuition reimbursement
* Mileage reimbursement
* Short- and long-term disability, life insurance, and well-being programs
* Paid time off
* Culture of professional development and career growth opportunities
* Flexible work schedule to accommodate you and your customers’ needs
* Click here to view our full benefit offerings

**Why you’ll love working here:**

* We **boldly shape the future**, embracing change, taking smart risks, and continuously improving to create the best experiences.
* We **lead by taking ownership**, empowering you to make decisions, solve problems proactively, and support each other with empathy.
* We **elevate to serve a greater purpose**, going above and beyond to earn trust, celebrate wins, and value every perspective.
* We **unite and win together**, fostering teamwork, breaking down silos, and achieving shared goals through inclusivity and collaboration.

Philadelphia Applicants: Background checks will be conducted during the employment process. Any information will be reviewed through an individualized assessment in accordance with the Philadelphia Fair Criminal Record Screening Standards Ordinance.

**Find Your Career With LiftOne**

We’re a family-owned company under our fourth generation of leadership and have built our business based on the principles of trust, integrity and a desire to help our customers and employees succeed.

LiftOne invests in people, facilities and innovative technology as part of the essential role we play in supporting our country’s supply chain and enabling critical goods to be delivered to homes and businesses. We’re a privately held company, and pair our scale with a strong foundation in our culture and values. This combination gives us a competitive advantage in the market and helps make us a trailblazing organization that is built to last.

We’re looking for hard-working, team-oriented professionals who enjoy working on new challenges every day. We believe our employees are the key to our success, and we’re committed to providing a work experience that helps our team grow to their full potential. We offer great benefits, competitive salaries and opportunities for advancement to all our employees.

Be a part of the essential work we do at LiftOne and make a difference for our customers, our community and our company. Learn more about what it means to become a team member with LiftOne.

**Summary**

Are you ready to become part of something special? Join one of the industry’s largest Material Handling networks as a Business Development Representative! As a Business Development Representative, you are responsible for driving your own career, we just provide the fuel!

Our program provides hands-on training in the following: inside sales, outside sales (Account Manger ride-alongs), operations (shadowing), as well as our extensive product lines.

Business Development Representatives (BDRs) work to find new sales leads through business directories, personal research, client referrals, and existing company resources. BDRs are friendly, well-spoken, not discouraged by hearing no, and have a strong work ethic. BDRs will assist Account Managers (AM) by referring qualified leads and in maintaining and developing existing accounts.

Develop a thorough understanding of the company’s product lines, technical aspects, business cycle, and customer support. This knowledge will be obtained through the following non-inclusive list:

* Other duties as assigned.

: Push yourself on hard and soft skills training and development, continuously. Develop and deliver technically competent, customer facing product walk-arounds, product demonstrations and sales presentations that align with customer goals, challenges, and growth objectives.

jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

The Operations Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and managing the flow of materials, equipment, vendor commitments, logistics, field scheduling, and service activity required to support Solar Energy Partners Operations. The role is the primary Operations owner for material readiness, procurement visibility, and the field schedule for all field work, including installations, site surveys, and service visits, and is accountable for ensuring that service work is properly received, documented, coordinated, tracked, and moved through completion.

**Core Accountabilities**
=========================

**Procurement & Cost Control**
------------------------------

* Coordinate purchasing of approved project materials, equipment, rentals, and other assigned operational requirements.
* Obtain, compare, and document vendor pricing, availability, lead times, and delivery commitments.
* Create and maintain clear visibility of purchase status, backorders, substitutions, and expected delivery dates.
* Support project cost control by maintaining accurate purchasing information and identifying material or vendor cost risks early.
* Escalate material substitutions, design conflicts, or specification questions for technical approval before purchase.

**Material Readiness & Logistics**
----------------------------------

* Maintain forward visibility of material requirements for the active installation schedule and identify jobs at risk because of material, equipment, or vendor constraints.
* Coordinate receiving, inventory location, staging, job pulls, transfers, deliveries, and other assigned logistics activities.
* Coordinate equipment rentals and related delivery/pickup requirements as assigned.
* Work with Field Operations and Project Management to confirm that required materials are available before scheduled work begins.

**Field Scheduling**
--------------------

* Own the schedule for all field work, including installations, site surveys, service visits, and other assigned field activities.
* Schedule work only after prerequisites are confirmed, including material readiness, permit/interconnection milestones, customer availability, and crew and equipment availability.
* Coordinate with Field Operations on crew availability, capacity, job duration estimates, and sequencing to build a realistic, conflict-free schedule.
* Confirm appointments with customers and communicate schedule changes promptly to customers, field crews, Project Management, and other affected stakeholders.
* Manage reschedules, cancellations, weather delays, and scheduling conflicts, and keep the schedule current in Coperniq.
* Maintain forward visibility of the upcoming field schedule and crew capacity, and flag gaps, overbooking, or jobs at risk of slipping.

**Service Coordination**
------------------------

* Receive and organize service requests in accordance with the approved Operations workflow.
* Ensure service opportunities, work orders, notes, supporting documentation, and status information are entered and maintained in Coperniq.
* Coordinate service needs with Field Operations and schedule field service visits in accordance with the approved workflow.
* Track open service items from intake through field completion, documentation, closeout, and readiness for invoicing.
* Escalate service items that are aging, blocked, customer-sensitive, or likely to affect cost or schedule.

**Systems, Documentation & Reporting**
======================================

* Maintain complete and timely procurement, logistics, service, and vendor notes in Coperniq and other approved company systems.
* Document significant vendor communications, delivery commitments, shortages, backorders, schedule changes, service updates, and resolution status in the applicable job or opportunity file.
* Maintain weekly visibility of open purchase orders, material readiness, backorders, the upcoming field schedule, upcoming installation risks, service backlog, and completed service activity.
* Participate in Operations scorecard, KPI, L10, and other reporting processes as assigned by the Office Operations Manager.
* Support actual-cost and project-profitability reporting by providing accurate purchasing, rental, and material information when requested.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**
=================================

* Coordinate with Field Operations on field scheduling, crew capacity, installation readiness, site needs, service execution, deliveries, and material-related field issues.
* Coordinate with Project Managers on project timing, installation and site survey scheduling, permit/interconnection milestones, customer commitments, and material requirements.
* Work with HR, Accounting, and other administrative functions as needed to support approved Operations processes and documentation.

**Performance Expectations**
============================

* Material readiness for scheduled work and early identification of procurement or logistics risks.
* An accurate, current field schedule with prerequisites confirmed before work is dispatched, and timely communication of schedule changes.
* Timely and accurate purchase, vendor, delivery, and inventory status information.
* Consistent management of service intake, backlog, aging, documentation, and completion status.
* Accurate and timely use of Coperniq, including required notes and task/status updates.
* Responsiveness, ownership, communication, and follow-through across Operations handoffs.
* Achievement of assigned weekly scorecard measures and quarterly KPI targets.

**Qualifications / Capabilities**
=================================

* Strong organization, prioritization, follow-up, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vendors, projects, deadlines, and competing operational priorities.

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
ABOUT 8FLEET

8Fleet is hiring! We are a fast-growing technology and logistics company building the operational backbone for rideshare fleets, both driver-operated and autonomous. We run 24/7 operations with full-time drivers, a managed fleet of vehicles and a team that keeps it all moving. As we launch in Chicago, we are building our local team from the ground up.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an Operations Coordinator, based in Chicago, to keep our new market running every day. You will keep driver shifts covered, vehicles assigned and ready, and the team working from the same information. When something breaks at 6 a.m., you are the person who already knows and is fixing it.

This is an on-site, hands-on role for someone who likes a fast pace, thinks in systems and enjoys being the person everyone relies on. You will work closely with Chicago market leadership and help build the processes and reporting the team uses as the market grows. Strong coordinators here grow into supervisor, analyst and management roles.

SCHEDULE

Full-time, salaried, on-site in Chicago. This role supports a 24/7 operation, so some early mornings, evenings or weekends are expected, especially around launch.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Own Daily Coverage: Build and manage driver schedules and shift coverage, fill gaps quickly and keep vehicles earning.
* Keep Vehicles on the Road: Coordinate vehicle assignments, handoffs and availability with the Fleet Support and Maintenance teams so downtime stays low.
* Be the Operational Hub: Be the first point of contact for drivers and supervisors on day-to-day issues, and route what you cannot solve to the right owner fast.
* Run the Numbers: Track daily metrics such as coverage, utilization, attendance and vehicle status, and turn them into clear updates for leadership.
* Fix What Slows Us Down: Spot recurring problems, document how things should work and help put better processes and tools in place.
* Support the Launch: Help with onboarding logistics, driver communications, supplies and site needs as we stand up the Chicago market.

QUALIFICATIONS

* 2+ years in operations, dispatch, logistics, fleet, transportation or another fast-moving operations environment.
* Strong organization and follow-through: you close loops without being chased.
* Comfort with data. You are strong in Google Sheets or Excel and like using numbers to make decisions.
* Clear, calm communication with drivers, teammates and leadership, especially when things go sideways.
* Flexibility to support a 24/7 operation, including some early mornings, evenings or weekends.

NICE TO HAVE

* Experience in rideshare, delivery, rental car or fleet operations.
* Experience with scheduling or fleet tools such as Deputy, Samsara, Fleetio or similar.
* Experience launching a new market, site or operation.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish).

WHY 8FLEET

* Get in early and help build the Chicago operation, not just run it.
* Clear paths into supervisor, analyst and operations management roles as we scale.
* Medical, dental and vision, 401(k), paid time off and sick pay.

COMPENSATION

* $65,000 - $70,000 per year, plus equity

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

8Fleet is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Disclaimer: This job description may be updated at any time without prior notice.

Compensation Range: $65K - $70K

new_jobs.description:
The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long-term solutions.

**Position Purpose and Summary**

Every repair, vendor visit, permit renewal, and vehicle inspection at HTM begins as a request that someone has to receive, route, and follow through on until it is closed. The Operations Coordinator is that person.

Reporting to the Director of Operations, the Project Coordinator - Operations serves as the intake, dispatch, and coordination point for the Operations Department across Facilities and Maintenance, Safety, IT, Fleet Management, and Warehouse and Delivery Logistics. This role monitors and triages the MaintainX queue and assigns work to the appropriate staff member or approved vendor; maintains the departmental compliance calendar for licenses, permits, inspections, and fleet records; solicits quotes and issues purchase requests within assigned thresholds; reconciles vendor invoices; and compiles the reporting that department and senior leadership rely on. The Operations Coordinator supports both the Director of Operations and the Operations Manager.

Operations is a department where the cost of a dropped request is measured in a shelter without hot water or a van that cannot make a food run. The Operations Coordinator exists so that requests are not dropped, deadlines are not missed, and no repair, renewal, or inspection depends on someone remembering it. This is not clerical work performed in service of a department. It is the mechanism by which the department keeps its commitments.

**Responsibilities**

***Request Intake and Dispatch***

* Monitor the MaintainX queue and all Operations request channels throughout the workday. Log, categorize, and assign priority to every incoming request.
* Dispatch requests to the appropriate Facilities, Maintenance, Safety, IT, or Fleet staff member, or to an approved vendor, based on trade, site location, and urgency.
* Acknowledge every incoming request within the departmental 24-hour response standard. Confirm receipt to the requesting site and communicate an estimated response time.
* Redistribute open work when a staff member is unavailable or a site escalates. Notify the Director of Operations or Operations Leadership of any request that cannot be assigned within standard.
* Track open tickets through to closure. Follow up on aging work orders and escalate any request that exceeds the established resolution window.
* Recognize matters that require management judgment rather than routine routing, and escalate them promptly rather than resolving them independently.

***Vendor and Purchasing Coordination***

* Solicit and collect quotes from approved vendors. Assemble comparison documentation for the Director of Operations or Operations Manager where multiple quotes are required.
* Issue purchase requests and work orders to approved vendors within assigned dollar thresholds. Route any request exceeding the assigned threshold, or involving a vendor not on the approved list, to the Director of Operations for approval before any commitment is made.
* Schedule vendor site visits, service calls, and preventive maintenance appointments. Confirm site access and notify site leadership in advance.
* Maintain the vendor file including W-9s, certificates of insurance, business licenses, signed agreements, and contact records. Track expiration dates and request renewals before coverage or credentials lapse.
* Reconcile vendor invoices against work performed and approved quotes. Flag discrepancies to the Director of Operations before invoices are submitted for payment.

***Compliance Documentation and Tracking***

* Maintain the Operations compliance calendar covering facility licenses, permits, regulatory inspections, fire and life safety certifications, and DPH requirements. Issue advance notice of upcoming renewals and expirations.
* Assemble compliance documentation for audits, monitoring visits, and funder or regulatory requests.

***Reporting and Records***

* Maintain the departmental filing structure so that records are current, organized, complete, and retrievable.
* Prepare agendas, materials, and meeting notes for departmental meetings as directed.
* Provide status information to sites and internal departments on ticket status, repairs, and estimated response times.

***New Site Setup and Demobilization***

* Maintain the new site operational readiness checklist. Track the status of each item and report progress to the Director of Operations.
* Open and coordinate utility accounts, waste service, pest control, alarm monitoring, and recurring service contracts.
* Coordinate delivery and installation scheduling for furniture, equipment, and technology.
* Support demobilization logistics including account closure, equipment recovery, and record retention.

***Secondary Duties and Responsibilities***

* Provide administrative and scheduling support to the Director of Operations and the Operations Leadership.
* Maintain inventory of departmental supplies, keys, access credentials, and assigned equipment.
* Participate in departmental and organizational meetings, training, and committees as assigned.
* Additional tasks, projects, and responsibilities as assigned by the Director of Operations.
* This position requires occasional travel to multiple HTM locations. Travel percentage: 15%

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required. Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in business administration, operations management, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum two years of administrative, coordination, dispatch, or operations support experience required.
* Experience with work order or ticketing systems, vendor coordination, or compliance record keeping strongly preferred.
* Prior experience supporting a multi-site organization preferred.
* CalOSHA 10 Certification required; or ability to obtain within 90 days of hire.

* **Outreach:** Write messages that speak credibly to Director+ technical buyers. Personalize every touch to the account and the person.
* **Calling:** Calls are part of the mix, alongside email and LinkedIn. You're calling people you've researched, not dialing down a list all day.
* **Events:** Invite the right prospects to AE-hosted dinners and events, and make sure they show up.

**What you bring to the table**
===============================

* Incredibly fast learner - either with experience prospecting into engineering teams, or an ability to learn quickly
* Curiosity and the drive to show up, ask questions, work hard, and ride the highs and the lows. Absolutely non-negotiable
* Willingness to leverage AI powered technology to create efficiencies in your day to day cadence
* Ability to communicate credibly with technical buyers. You can hold a conversation with a Director or VP of Engineering about developer experience, documentation workflows, API strategy, and how AI agents read docs, without sounding like you're reading a script
* Strong written communication. Outreach reads like it was written by a thoughtful person, not a sequence tool. You personalize every touch for critical personas and accounts
* Research depth. You can look at an account and quickly understand why they're a fit, who the right contacts are, and what pain to lead with.
* Organizational discipline. CRM hygiene, clean handoff notes, systematic follow-up. You don't let things fall through the cracks.
* Appropriate Persistence. You know the difference between following up and spamming.
* Salesforce proficiency, outbound tooling including Nooks, Lemlist, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and others.

**Bonus Points****:**
=====================

* Prior SDR/BDR experience in B2B SaaS - particularly having sold to technical buyers or developer-focused companies
* Experience with event-based or dinner-based sales motions
* Background at a PLG or developer-tools company (you understand how product-led and sales-led motions coexist)

**Why you should join our sales team**
======================================

You'll be joining a company where the product sells itself to developers. Your job is instrumental in helping us bring Mintlify to the enterprise buyers who can deploy it at scale. The product-market fit is real. What we're building now is the sales motion to match.  
This is a ground-floor opportunity to build something. You won't be plugging into a mature SDR org with a playbook someone else wrote. You'll be writing the playbook and we'll be here to help you nail it.  
  
**Your path to AE**  
We hire SDRs to grow into AEs. You'll learn how enterprise deals get built from the first touch, and as you prove yourself, you'll move toward running deals of your own.

**Company Benefits:**
=====================

* Competitive compensation and equity
* 20 days paid time off every year
* 401k with Employer Match
* monthly wellness stipend
* 100% employee coverage for Health, Dental, Vision
* Commute stipend to help get you to and from work
* Free lunch and dinners
* Annual team offsite (previously went to Alaska, Hawaii, Jackson Hole)

Compensation Range: $80K - $115K

Founded in 1971 in Long Island City, Queens **,** LaGuardia Community College is one of seven community colleges of the City University of New York (CUNY). Virtually all LaGuardia students are ethnic minorities (89 percent), 58 percent are women, 27 percent are over the age of 25. Forty-six percent of associate degree students are Hispanic. **About the Whitney**  
The Whitney Museum of American Art, founded in 1930 by the artist and philanthropist Gertrude Vanderbilt Whitney, houses the foremost collection of American art from the twentieth and twenty-first centuries. **AUTONOMY TO OWN YOUR PATH.**

**MOST SALESPEOPLE WORK A TERRITORY.**

***You're going to build one.***

*DuraServ is looking for a hunter — someone who doesn't wait for leads, doesn't need a manager standing over their shoulder, and doesn't stop until the deal is closed.*

**Built for People Who Build Markets. Own Your Territory, Drive Your Income.**

Are you a high-energy "hunter" who thrives on the adrenaline of a cold call and the satisfaction of a closed deal? We are looking for a resilient Outside Sales & Business Development Representative to dominate our local industrial market. In this role, you aren't just a salesperson; you are a problem-solving partner for facility managers and general contractors. Backed by a team of elite service technicians, you will identify operational bottlenecks, pitch high-performance dock and door solutions, and build a book of business with **uncapped commission potential**. If you are a social influencer who competes with an underdog's grit and a professional's accountability, your future and your paycheck starts here.

DuraServ is the market leader in commercial dock and door solutions — the essential infrastructure that keeps warehouses, distribution centers, and industrial facilities running. Our clients don't come to us. We go to them. We earn their business through preparation, persistence, and the ability to show up with a solution before they knew they had a problem.

**THE MISSION**

**Company Overview:**

  
  

ADT has been in the business of helping save lives since 1874. As the #1 smart home security provider in the U.S., we help protect and connect families, businesses and larger commercial customer every day. Our continuous innovation, advanced technology and strategic partnerships deliver products and services that help protect life and valuables, whether at home, your business or on the go. And as times change, so do we.Above all, our mission is clear: we help save lives for a living. Looking for a career where you can make a real impact? Join our team today and put purpose behind your paycheck. #WeAreADT

*Check out more about life at ADT* here.

**What you should know about our team:**

At ADT, our Sales team is at the heart of everything we do. We’re not just selling security systems, we’re helping protect what matters most. Whether it’s a family home or a small business, our sales professionals are trusted advisors who bring peace of mind to customers across the country.

**What you will do:**

As a Resale Sales Representative, you are not starting from scratch; you are reactivating interest and rebuilding trust with customers who already know ADT. That’s a powerful head start! These customers represent one of ADT’s strategic growth opportunities, and you will be at the forefront of re-introducing modern solutions that better meet this customer segment’s needs. You will:

* Re-engage previous customers, not cold-calling strangers. That means shorter sales cycles, higher conversion rates, and real potential to build lasting relationships.
* Provide personalized solutions that combine security, automation, and life safety features, all tailored to their space and lifestyle.

* Deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals to prospects, emphasizing the unique benefits and advantages of our products and services compared to competitors.
* Conduct post-installation follow-ups with customers to confirm that commitments were fulfilled and to generate referrals.
* Cultivate new business opportunities: identify and generate new sales leads to maximize outreach.

**What you need to be successful:**

We’re looking for self-motivated, tech-savvy individuals who are passionate about helping others and driven to succeed. If you thrive on connection, enjoy solving problems, and want to make a real impact while growing your career, you’ll fit right in.

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Willing to travel within a designated territory using your own vehicle (mileage reimbursed).
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving record required; additional licensing may be needed based on location.
* Comfortable using technology to stay organized, efficient, and accountable in a fast-paced sales environment.
* Self-motivated and results-driven, with an entrepreneurial mindset; you thrive on uncovering new leads and closing deals that deliver real value.
* Strong communicator and natural relationship builder, able to consult with customers, understand their needs, and guide them to the right solution.
* Adaptable and flexible; you excel in dynamic environments and enjoy learning new systems and approaches.
* Consumer sales experience is preferred but not required.

**How ADT invests in you:**

**Compensation:** Unlimited earning potential with uncapped commissions. Based upon performance, new sales advisors can expect to earn $105,000, while experienced sales advisors can earn over $150,000.

**Additional Pay:** We equip you with specialized training and the tools you need to meet your financial goals. For your first 8 weeks of training, you’ll earn up to $4,000.

**Benefits:**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Tuition reimbursement
* Mileage reimbursement
* Short- and long-term disability, life insurance, and well-being programs
* Paid time off
* Culture of professional development and career growth opportunities
* Flexible work schedule to accommodate you and your customers’ needs
* Click here to view our full benefit offerings

**Why you’ll love working here:**

* We **boldly shape the future**, embracing change, taking smart risks, and continuously improving to create the best experiences.
* We **lead by taking ownership**, empowering you to make decisions, solve problems proactively, and support each other with empathy.
* We **elevate to serve a greater purpose**, going above and beyond to earn trust, celebrate wins, and value every perspective.
* We **unite and win together**, fostering teamwork, breaking down silos, and achieving shared goals through inclusivity and collaboration.

new_jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

The Operations Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and managing the flow of materials, equipment, vendor commitments, logistics, field scheduling, and service activity required to support Solar Energy Partners Operations. The role is the primary Operations owner for material readiness, procurement visibility, and the field schedule for all field work, including installations, site surveys, and service visits, and is accountable for ensuring that service work is properly received, documented, coordinated, tracked, and moved through completion.

**Core Accountabilities**
=========================

**Procurement & Cost Control**
------------------------------

* Coordinate purchasing of approved project materials, equipment, rentals, and other assigned operational requirements.
* Obtain, compare, and document vendor pricing, availability, lead times, and delivery commitments.
* Create and maintain clear visibility of purchase status, backorders, substitutions, and expected delivery dates.
* Support project cost control by maintaining accurate purchasing information and identifying material or vendor cost risks early.
* Escalate material substitutions, design conflicts, or specification questions for technical approval before purchase.

**Material Readiness & Logistics**
----------------------------------

* Maintain forward visibility of material requirements for the active installation schedule and identify jobs at risk because of material, equipment, or vendor constraints.
* Coordinate receiving, inventory location, staging, job pulls, transfers, deliveries, and other assigned logistics activities.
* Coordinate equipment rentals and related delivery/pickup requirements as assigned.
* Work with Field Operations and Project Management to confirm that required materials are available before scheduled work begins.

**Field Scheduling**
--------------------

* Own the schedule for all field work, including installations, site surveys, service visits, and other assigned field activities.
* Schedule work only after prerequisites are confirmed, including material readiness, permit/interconnection milestones, customer availability, and crew and equipment availability.
* Coordinate with Field Operations on crew availability, capacity, job duration estimates, and sequencing to build a realistic, conflict-free schedule.
* Confirm appointments with customers and communicate schedule changes promptly to customers, field crews, Project Management, and other affected stakeholders.
* Manage reschedules, cancellations, weather delays, and scheduling conflicts, and keep the schedule current in Coperniq.
* Maintain forward visibility of the upcoming field schedule and crew capacity, and flag gaps, overbooking, or jobs at risk of slipping.

**Service Coordination**
------------------------

* Receive and organize service requests in accordance with the approved Operations workflow.
* Ensure service opportunities, work orders, notes, supporting documentation, and status information are entered and maintained in Coperniq.
* Coordinate service needs with Field Operations and schedule field service visits in accordance with the approved workflow.
* Track open service items from intake through field completion, documentation, closeout, and readiness for invoicing.
* Escalate service items that are aging, blocked, customer-sensitive, or likely to affect cost or schedule.

**Systems, Documentation & Reporting**
======================================

* Maintain complete and timely procurement, logistics, service, and vendor notes in Coperniq and other approved company systems.
* Document significant vendor communications, delivery commitments, shortages, backorders, schedule changes, service updates, and resolution status in the applicable job or opportunity file.
* Maintain weekly visibility of open purchase orders, material readiness, backorders, the upcoming field schedule, upcoming installation risks, service backlog, and completed service activity.
* Participate in Operations scorecard, KPI, L10, and other reporting processes as assigned by the Office Operations Manager.
* Support actual-cost and project-profitability reporting by providing accurate purchasing, rental, and material information when requested.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**
=================================
